description: Clarify-first intake for Korean tax, accounting, labor, administrative and court/registry problems (e.g. a tax notice, missed filing, inheritance/gift filing, home sale, bookkeeping duty, external audit test, dismissal, unpaid wages, workplace harassment, industrial accident, business suspension, permit refusal, fines, information disclosure, inheritance renunciation, ownership transfer registration, collecting a debt, jeonse deposit, corporate change registration). Call it BEFORE answering: send the user's situation (or a topic id) and any answers collected so far; it returns the next 1-3 questions to ask (with why each matters), deadlines computed from the answers (first day excluded, month-end rules, weekend/holiday roll-over; national tax also skips Workers' Day) with days left, warnings with statute citations, plain-language statutes with law.go.kr links, OIYO calculators, documents to bring, free public help lines and when a licensed professional is needed. Legal information only — not tax/labor/legal representation.

answers.description: Answers collected so far, keyed by the question keys this tool returned (strings, numbers in KRW / months / days, YYYY-MM-DD dates, 'yes'/'no'). Up to 20 keys.

domain.description: Optional: restrict topic matching to one field

limit.description: How many next questions to return (default 3)

situation.description: The user's situation in their own words (Korean works best). Used to pick the topic when topic is omitted.

today.description: Reference date YYYY-MM-DD for days left (default: today in Asia/Seoul)

topic.description: Topic id from a previous call. Overrides situation.
